test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 7 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct homonym from the given options to fill in the blank.

The athlete's ___________ was badly injured due to a fall on the track.
solution:
The correct answer is '**toe**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **most appropriate** homonym to fill in the blank is '**toe**'.
 
• The word '**toe**' means 'any of the five jointed parts at the front of the human foo
